info.name: Marlink PRA API v2.0.1
info.description:
Comprehensive API collection for Marlink PRA API. This collection includes all available endpoints except those excluded from Swagger documentation (auth endpoints).

Health Module Features:
- Comprehensive health check (/health) - monitors database, disk, memory, and external APIs
- Kubernetes readiness probe (/health/readiness) - checks if service can handle requests
- Kubernetes liveness probe (/health/liveness) - minimal check for container restart decisions

All health endpoints return JSON responses compatible with monitoring systems like Prometheus.

variable.description: Maximum time to wait for health checks (in milliseconds)
Interval between health checks for monitoring (in milliseconds)

item.name: Health
item.description:
Health monitoring endpoints for the PRA API. These endpoints provide different levels of health checking suitable for various monitoring scenarios:

- `/health` - Comprehensive health check monitoring database, system resources, and external APIs
- `/health/readiness` - Kubernetes readiness probe checking if the service can accept traffic
- `/health/liveness` - Kubernetes liveness probe for basic functionality verification

All endpoints return standardized JSON responses with detailed status information for each component.

request.description:
Comprehensive health check that monitors:
- Database connectivity (TypeORM)
- Disk storage usage (configurable threshold)
- Memory heap usage (configurable threshold)
- PRA Sync API connectivity

Returns detailed status for each component. Used by monitoring systems like Prometheus/Grafana.

request.description:
Kubernetes readiness probe that checks if the service is ready to accept traffic. Monitors:
- Database connectivity
- PRA Sync API connectivity

If this fails, Kubernetes will stop routing traffic to this pod until it passes.

request.description:
Kubernetes liveness probe that performs minimal health checking. Only monitors:
- Database connectivity (basic ping)

If this fails, Kubernetes will restart the container. Should only fail in catastrophic scenarios where the application is completely unresponsive.

Deactivates a customer and triggers user login disable workflow via saga. The customer becomes inactive but is not deleted from the system.
Reactivates a previously deactivated customer. The customer becomes active again and associated users can log in.
Permanently deletes a customer from the system. The customer must not have any associated sites, otherwise the operation will fail with a 409 Conflict.
